eventScripts.script:
#on change, reset counters and record  records in database
	now =system.date.now()
	logger = system.util.getLogger("exchange.launchpad.oee.tagChange")
	
	tagReadPaths = ["[.]../Plc/ProductionCounter","[.]../Plc/RejectCounter","[.]../LineName","[.]../LinePath", "[.]../Config/RateName", "[.]../Config/TargetRate","[.]StartTime","[.]IntervalType", "[.]Enabled","[.]PreviousInterval"]
	tagValues = system.tag.readBlocking(tagReadPaths)
	startCounter = tagValues[0].value
	startReject = tagValues[1].value
	lineName = tagValues[2].value
	prevIntervalStart = tagValues[6].value	
	intervalType = tagValues[7].value
	enabled = tagValues[8].value	
	prevInterval = tagValues[9].value
	targetRate = tagValues[5].value
	targetRateName = tagValues[4].value	
	currentInterval = currentValue.value
	
	#execute on  change, or when new instance is created and no start time has been recorded
	if (not initialChange or prevIntervalStart==None) and enabled:
		#logger.info("Current Interval %s Change %s %s %s" %(intervalType, currentValue, currentValue.value, currentInterval))
		#read values from line UDT instance
		lineValue = system.tag.readBlocking([tagValues[3].value])[0].value
		# initialize variables
		if startCounter == None: startCounter = 0
		if startReject == None: startReject = 0
		#set zero milliseconds on the new interval start
		intervalStart = system.date.addSeconds(system.date.addMillis(now, 0-system.date.getMillis(now)), 0-system.date.getSecond(now))
			
		if prevIntervalStart and intervalType == "Hour":
			#record end of hour
			exchange.launchpad.oee.recordHourEnd( lineName, lineValue,prevIntervalStart )
		
		#reset running time
		tagWritePaths = ["[.]RunSeconds"] 
		tagWritePaths.append("[.]DownSeconds")
		tagWriteValues = [0,0]
		#set starting production counter and reject counter
		tagWritePaths.append("[.]StartCounter")
		tagWriteValues.append(startCounter)
		tagWritePaths.append("[.]StartReject")
		tagWriteValues.append(startReject)
		#set  start time
		tagWritePaths.append("[.]StartTime")
		tagWriteValues.append(intervalStart)

		#reset target production
		targetRateHistory = exchange.launchpad.oee.getTargetRateDataset(targetRateName, targetRate)
		tagWritePaths.append("[.]TargetRateHistory")
		tagWriteValues.append(targetRateHistory)

		#set tag values
		system.tag.writeAsync(tagWritePaths, tagWriteValues)
		
		if enabled and intervalType == "Hour":
			#start new database record for the current hour
			#logger.info("Recording start of hour %s starting %s" %(currentInterval,intervalStart))
			exchange.launchpad.oee.recordHourStart(currentInterval ,intervalStart, lineName, lineValue)
		if currentInterval > 0 and intervalType == "Shift":
			#start new database record for the current shift
			exchange.launchpad.oee.recordShiftStart(currentInterval, lineName, lineValue)

#set counters and second timers for the new interval start
	logger = system.util.getLogger("exchange.launchpad.oee.tagChange")
	now =system.date.now()
	intervalStart = system.date.addSeconds(system.date.addMillis(now, 0-system.date.getMillis(now)), 0-system.date.getSecond(now))
	
	if currentValue.value == 0:
		system.tag.writeBlocking(["[.]StartTime"],None)
	else:
		system.tag.writeBlocking(["[.]StartTime"], intervalStart)
	
	tagReadPaths = ["[.]../Plc/ProductionCounter","[.]../Plc/RejectCounter","[.]../LineName","[.]../LinePath", "[.]../Config/RateName", "[.]../Config/TargetRate","[.]StartTime","[.]IntervalType", "[.]Enabled","[.]PreviousInterval"]
	tagValues = system.tag.readBlocking(tagReadPaths)
	startCounter = tagValues[0].value
	startReject = tagValues[1].value
	lineName = tagValues[2].value
	targetRateName = tagValues[4].value	
	targetRate = tagValues[5].value
	prevIntervalStart = tagValues[6].value	
	intervalType = tagValues[7].value
	enabled = tagValues[8].value	
	prevInterval = tagValues[9].value
	
	logger.info("Enabled lineName %s %s, intervalStart %s, startCounter %d, starting reject %d" %(lineName, intervalType, intervalStart, startCounter, startReject))
	
	#set run seconds and down seconds to zero
	tagWritePaths = ["[.]RunSeconds"] 
	tagWritePaths.append("[.]DownSeconds")
	tagWriteValues = [0,0]
	#set starting production counter and reject counter
	tagWritePaths.append("[.]StartCounter")
	tagWriteValues.append(startCounter)
	tagWritePaths.append("[.]StartReject")
	tagWriteValues.append(startReject)
	#set  start time
	tagWritePaths.append("[.]StartTime")
	tagWriteValues.append(intervalStart)
	
	#reset target production
	targetRateHistory = exchange.launchpad.oee.getTargetRateDataset(targetRateName, targetRate)
	tagWritePaths.append("[.]TargetRateHistory")
	tagWriteValues.append(targetRateHistory)
	
	#set tag values
	system.tag.writeAsync(tagWritePaths, tagWriteValues)

if not initialChange and currentValue.value > previousValue.value:
		#update OEE seconds in each state
		logger = system.util.getLogger("exchange.launchpad.oee.tagScripts")
		timeIncrement = currentValue.value - previousValue.value 	 
		#get current tags values
		tagReadPaths = ["[.]CurrentInterval", "[.]../Plc/State","[.]RunSeconds","[.]DownSeconds","[.]TargetRateHistory" ]
		tagValues = system.tag.readBlocking(tagReadPaths)
		secondsElapsed = currentValue.value
		lineState = tagValues[1].value
		runningSeconds = tagValues[2].value
		downSeconds = tagValues[3].value
		targetRateHistory = tagValues[4].value
		rowIndex = targetRateHistory.rowCount-1
		#logger.info("Seconds Elapsed Timer (%d) : lineState %d, runningSeconds %d, downSeconds %d" %(timeIncrement, lineState,runningSeconds,downSeconds)  )
		if rowIndex >=0:
			rateRunningSeconds = targetRateHistory.getValueAt(rowIndex,"SecondsRunning")
			rateDownSeconds = targetRateHistory.getValueAt(rowIndex,"SecondsFaulted")
			rateIdleSeconds = targetRateHistory.getValueAt(rowIndex,"SecondsIdle")
			rateSeconds = targetRateHistory.getValueAt(rowIndex,"SecondsElapsed")
			
		if runningSeconds == None: hourRunningSeconds = 0
		if downSeconds == None: hourDownSeconds = 0
		#update timers
		if  lineState == 1 and timeIncrement > 0:
			#update the number of seconds the line has been up during the hour
			tagWritePaths = ["[.]RunSeconds",  "[.]TargetRateHistory"]
			if rowIndex >=0:
				targetRateHistory = system.dataset.setValue(targetRateHistory, rowIndex, "SecondsRunning", min(rateRunningSeconds + timeIncrement,secondsElapsed))
				targetRateHistory = system.dataset.setValue(targetRateHistory, rowIndex, "SecondsElapsed", min(rateSeconds + timeIncrement,secondsElapsed))
			system.tag.writeAsync(tagWritePaths, [min(runningSeconds + timeIncrement, secondsElapsed), targetRateHistory])
		if  lineState == 2 and timeIncrement>0:
			#update the number of seconds the line has been faulted during the hour
			tagWritePaths = ["[.]DownSeconds", "[.]TargetRateHistory"]
			if rowIndex >=0:
				targetRateHistory = system.dataset.setValue(targetRateHistory, rowIndex, "SecondsFaulted", min(rateDownSeconds + timeIncrement,secondsElapsed))
				targetRateHistory = system.dataset.setValue(targetRateHistory, rowIndex, "SecondsElapsed", min(rateSeconds + timeIncrement,secondsElapsed))
			system.tag.writeAsync(tagWritePaths, [min(downSeconds + timeIncrement, secondsElapsed) ,targetRateHistory])
		if  lineState == 0 and timeIncrement>0:
			tagWritePaths = ["[.]TargetRateHistory"]
			if rowIndex >=0:
				targetRateHistory = system.dataset.setValue(targetRateHistory, rowIndex, "SecondsIdle", min(rateIdleSeconds + timeIncrement,secondsElapsed))
				targetRateHistory = system.dataset.setValue(targetRateHistory, rowIndex, "SecondsElapsed", min(rateSeconds + timeIncrement,secondsElapsed))
			system.tag.writeAsync(tagWritePaths, targetRateHistory)

if not initialChange:
		
		logger = system.util.getLogger("exchange.launchpad.oee.tagChange")
		#adjust after counter has reset to zero
		if currentValue.value == 0 and previousValue.value > 0:
			#first get starting counts
			logger.info("Reject counter reset")
			tagReadPaths = ["[.]../HourOee/StartReject" , "[.]../ShiftOee/StartReject", "[.]../DayOee/StartReject"]
			tagWritePaths = ["[.]../HourOee/StartReject" , "[.]../ShiftOee/StartReject", "[.]../DayOee/StartReject"]
			tagValues = system.tag.readBlocking(tagReadPaths)
			#OEE Reject Count = previous PLC Reject Count - Starting Count
			#new starting count = zero - OEE Reject Count
			
			tagWriteValues = [0- (previousValue.value - tagValues[0].value)]	#Hour OEE
			tagWriteValues.append(0- (previousValue.value - tagValues[1].value))	#Shift OEE
			tagWriteValues.append(0- (previousValue.value - tagValues[2].value))	#Day OEE
			
			system.tag.writeBlocking(tagWritePaths, tagWriteValues)

if not initialChange:
		
		logger = system.util.getLogger("exchange.launchpad.oee.tagChange")
		#adjust after counter has reset to zero
		if currentValue.value == 0 and previousValue.value > 0:
			#first get starting counts
			logger.info("Reject counter reset")
			tagReadPaths = ["[.]../HourOee/StartCounter" , "[.]../ShiftOee/StartCounter", "[.]../DayOee/StartCounter"]
			tagWritePaths = ["[.]../HourOee/StartCounter" , "[.]../ShiftOee/StartCounter", "[.]../DayOee/StartCounter"]
			tagValues = system.tag.readBlocking(tagReadPaths)
			#OEE Production Count = previous PLC Production Count - Starting Count
			#new starting count = zero - OEE Production Count
			
			tagWriteValues = [0- (previousValue.value - tagValues[0].value)]	#Hour OEE
			tagWriteValues.append(0- (previousValue.value - tagValues[1].value))	#Shift OEE
			tagWriteValues.append(0- (previousValue.value - tagValues[2].value))	#Day OEE
			
			system.tag.writeBlocking(tagWritePaths, tagWriteValues)
			
			
			#logger.info("PLC Outfeed tag change.  Hour Start Counter %d ShiftPC %d, Day PC %d" %(tagValues[1].value,tagValues[2].value,tagValues[3].value))

if not initialChange:
		logger = system.util.getLogger("exchange.launchpad.oee.tagChange")
		prevShift = previousValue.value
		tagReadPaths = ["[.]../ShiftOee/StartTime", "[.]../LineName", "[.]../LinePath"]
		tagValues = system.tag.readBlocking(tagReadPaths)
		prevShiftStart = tagValues[0].value
		lineName = tagValues[1].value
		linePath = tagValues[2].value
		lineValue = system.tag.readBlocking(linePath)[0].value
		#record shift end
		if prevShift > 0:
			exchange.launchpad.oee.recordShiftEnd(prevShift, lineName, lineValue, prevShiftStart )
		#start next shift
		shiftDuration = system.tag.readBlocking(["[.]%s/ShiftSeconds" %(currentValue.value)])[0].value
		tagWritePaths = ["[.]../ShiftOee/CurrentInterval", "[.]../ShiftOee/PreviousInterval", "[.]../ShiftOee/Duration"]
		tagWriteValues = [currentValue.value, previousValue.value,shiftDuration]
		system.tag.writeBlocking(tagWritePaths, tagWriteValues)
